title: data-root/cgwb-stations contract (Tier A)
description: CGWB/WRIS observation wells with reading series. provenance.conventions.sign is REQUIRED in practice: WRIS depth signs are programme-dependent and a naive reader WILL compute inverted trends (spec 7.5; the per-station sign rule).

year_book_summaries.description: CGWB Year Book district summaries. Promoted from per-city extension: present in 2+ cities (Madurai, Mumbai) - spec 6.3 promotion rule.

quality_note.description: Chemistry-panel caption (units, sampling vintage). Declared platform-wide in src/types/groundwater.ts CgwbStationsFile - contract completion 2026-07-30 (Mumbai migration), not a per-scope addition.

series_label.description: Short provenance label shown on each station panel (defaults to 'CGWB Year Book'; Delhi overrides - its series comes from the India-WRIS API). Declared platform-wide in src/types/groundwater.ts CgwbStationsFile - contract completion 2026-07-30.

unit_label.description: CGWB assessment-unit label ('block' in TN/KA, 'district' in Delhi). Declared platform-wide in src/types/groundwater.ts CgwbStationsFile - contract completion 2026-07-30.

reading_kind.description: Reading-cadence phrase for map headers ('seasonal readings' vs Delhi's 'monthly means'). Declared platform-wide in src/types/groundwater.ts CgwbStationsFile - contract completion 2026-07-30.

cadence_note.description: How the wells are actually read (manual seasonal vs telemetric). Declared platform-wide in src/types/groundwater.ts CgwbStationsFile - contract completion 2026-07-30.

readings.description: Series shape (spec 6.1): ISO dates, unit-suffixed depth keys.
